evidence.quote: Posted: 23 Jun 2020 Resource Type: Multimedia Back Investments in technological solutions across financial organisations are now more important than ever, as the world shifts towards remote working and online communication channels due to the COVID-19 pandemic. As one of the world’s leading global financial centres, the UK has established a unique position to equip SMEs and financial institutions globally with the required tools to effectively conduct business both during and after this time of crisis. In this webinar, we explore how the wealth management industry can thrive through investing in and collaborating with fintech, the key to success for investing in fintech companies, the role of the UK fintech wealth management sector post COVID-19 and how the UK can continue to strengthen its international partnerships with growing markets including China. Speakers: Alderman William Russel
